info.name: Didit Verification Regulatory Reports API
info.description: Identity verification API. Authenticate with x-api-key header.

request.description: List FIU reports generated for the case.

Create a draft FIU report for the case: DRAFT status, auto-populated from the optional template plus the case's subject, linked transactions, and narrative. Validate then finalize to produce the goAML XML and PDF.

response.name: The referenced template was not found.

request.description: Check the report against the obligatory goAML header fields (reporting entity ID, submission code, local currency, action taken, submission date), plus at least one attached transaction and a 2-letter jurisdiction, without generating any files. Also stores the result on the report: validation_errors and validated_at are updated, and a non-finalized report's status moves to VALIDATED (no errors) or back to DRAFT (errors).
Re-validate, then render the goAML XML and PDF and upload both to S3. On SAR/STR/TFR reports, this also moves the case's transaction alerts from Pending SAR to SAR filed.

response.name: Report finalized; xml_s3_key and pdf_s3_key are set.
Report is not in a finalizable state.

request.description: Mint a presigned URL for a finalized report's goAML XML or PDF.
Edit a draft or validated report's fields. Finalized reports cannot be edited (409).
Delete a draft or validated report. Finalized reports cannot be deleted (409).
